end.summary:
Deciding between exact and approximate values was practised: easy questions were answered right; a why or new-situation question is still to check.
Rounding to lakh and crore was practised; some answers were right, but the method was not steady yet.
The child first chose 8 lakh for a 7,75,000-type example, then corrected the approach by checking the relevant digit directly in later turns.
Judging the size of rounding error was practised; some answers were right, but this is not steady yet.
end.parentNote: Asha practised choosing exact or approximate values, rounding large numbers, and judging rounding error. Ayaan used sensible reasons for exact values in fees and bank amounts, and later corrected the rounding method by checking the relevant digit directly rather than rounding in stages. Rounding and error-size questions still need more practice with new examples. At home, give one number at a time and ask Ayaan to name the place being rounded, the deciding digit, and whether the result is exact or approximate.
